contributionMap.claim: When an S(2,r,n) exists, uniform sampling of its blocks as omitted sets maximises P(T > j) over all balanced laws for every j, and equality at any single j >= 2 characterises the design; it is the slowest fair law in mean (seven coupons, packages of four: 47/12 against 257/68); partial-coverage analogue with higher designs
